title: Embedded Tape Index Is Selected
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $\iota:\mathrm{Fin}(m)\hookrightarrow\mathrm{Fin}(k)$ be an embedding, and let $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(m)$. The slot selected at tape index $\iota(i)$ is exactly $i$.
